 REPLAY: Sam Houston-Hahnville playoff football 
 Louisiana High School Football Scoreboard 
 Friday Night Live: Louisiana high school football playoffs (scores, reports, live games)
 November 13, 2026
 Posted by: CCS Staff
 Category: Preps 
 (Photo: Jordan Harris) 
 It’s Friday the 13th, but never fear. Playoff time is here! We’re tracking games in all eight brackets on the road to the Dome.
 Find your scores first on the state’s only comprehensive real-time scoreboard  presented by the Allstate Sugar Bowl. 
 Live from Boutte, we bring you the Division I Non-Select matchup between Sam Houston and Hahnville. Watch the free stream here .
 Listen to live updates, interviews, and analysis of all the game action across Louisiana from 6 to 11 p.m.  on Ken Trahan’s Original Prep Football Report on the 106.7 The Ticket New Orleans flagship .
